: binding @ beta-2 receptors → relaxation of bronchiole smooth musc/bronchodilation
, used PRN for acute Sx (quickly reverses bronchospasm)
: nervousness, tremor, tachy, palpitations, cough, hyperglycemia, hypokalemia
Direct Acting – mimic NE/EPI by directly binding to adrenoreceptor
: nervousness, tremor, tachy, palpitations, cough, hyperglycemia, hypokalemia
New Asthma guidelines (GINA 2019) recommend ↓dose budesonide/formoterol 80-4.5mcg inhaler over albuterol (SABA) for preferred as-needed rescue inhaler
: block constricting action of acetylcholine @ M3 receptors in bronchial smooth musc resulting in bronchodilation; also ⇣ mucus secretion
: may be used in combo w/ SABAs during exacerbations
: Myasthenia gravis, narrow-angle glaucoma, urinary retention, BPH, bladder neck obstruct
: dry mouth, blurred vision, thirst, dry eyes
: act directly @ parasympathetic postganglionic cholinergic muscarinic receptors & compete reversibly w/ ACh for receptor binding
: dry mouth, URTIs, cough, bitter taste
*Spiriva Respimat 1.25mcg = indicated for asthma and 2.5mcg = for COPD

Inhibits #/activity of cells involved in inflam response
